# Vibelly

> Vibelly (https://vibelly.fun) is a free, browser-based random video chat for adults 18+, run by Naimish Omar. Users are matched with strangers worldwide for video or text chat, with no account needed to chat. Free video is 480p. Vibelly Premium (from ₹49/month) adds gender and country filters, 720p HD video, and voice-only calls. Every call has a Report button; reports are reviewed by hand and rule-breakers are banned. Calls are encrypted in transit and never recorded.
